title: Good: Signature verification precedes replay window check
description:
Location: rust/lichen-link/src/link_layer.rs lines 531-578

receive_frame() performs operations in correct security order:
1. Parse frame (lines 516-525)
2. Verify signature (lines 531-547)
3. Check key pinning (lines 555-565)
4. Check replay window (lines 567-578)
5. Pin key and update state (lines 580-599)

Critically, the replay window is NOT updated until AFTER signature verification passes. This prevents an attacker from advancing a victim's replay window by sending unsigned or malformed frames.

Worth defending - reordering would create a DoS vector.
